links.comparator_used: Patients just below the EDI threshold of 65.0 who did not trigger the alert or the collaborative huddle workflow (regression discontinuity)
links.outcome: Escalations in care (RRT activation, ICU transfer, or cardiopulmonary arrest)
links.effect: Absolute risk reduction of -10.4 percentage points (95% CI, -20.1 to -0.8; P = .03) at the threshold; secondary outcome including inpatient death -7.0 points (95% CI, -16.6 to 2.6; P = .15); inpatient death -0.4 points (95% CI, -6.4 to 5.6; P = .88)
links.tradeoff: The package could not be separated into its components, so the effect of the alert versus the workflow is unknown. Sensitivity analyses showed 95% CIs including 0 at bandwidths greater than 9 points. No specific preventive action was required.
links.quote: The RDD analysis estimated an absolute risk reduction of −10.4 percentage points (95% CI, −20.1 to −0.8 percentage points; P = .03) in the primary outcome for patients at the EDI score threshold.

design_hint: AI-triggered alerting workflow with nurse-physician collaborative response
